item.title: Horas extras y binoculares de visión nocturna: UC San Diego es una de las agencias ayudando a patrullar la frontera
item.description: Las fuerzas policiales locales reciben fondos cada año del Departamento de Seguridad Nacional para apoyar las operaciones de patrullaje fronterizo. Esto incluye al Departamento de Policía de la Universidad de California en San Diego, que ayuda a controlar el contrabando en la costa.

item.title: Are TikTok and X tracking you across the internet? Our privacy tool can tell you
item.description: We’ve updated Blacklight, The Markup’s privacy inspector, to help you understand how sites are tracking you.

item.title: Newsom takes aim at veterans ‘claim sharks’ as he signs law banning fees for help with VA
item.description: Many veterans turn to private companies for help filing disability claims at the Department of Veterans Affairs and then face bills that run well into the thousands of dollars.

item.title: Two ads during Super Bowl hint at a high-dollar ballot battle in California next fall
item.description: Uber's ballot measure would limit the ability of injured passengers to sue. Three lawyer-back measures would hold rideshare companies responsible.

item.title: Mental health advocate for California tribes dies; possible victim in murder-suicide
item.description: Celinda Gonzales of the Yurok Tribe worked to prevent suicides among Native Americans after experiencing loss in her family. She "was a friend to many," the tribe said.

item.title: California promised accountability for inmate deaths in jails. A year later, no results.
item.description: Lawmakers passed a law creating a state department to review inmate deaths, but it hasn’t completed a single death review in its first year.

item.title: Judge rules on CA’s mask ban for law enforcement
item.description: A federal judge has pumped the brakes on a California law banning local and federal officers from wearing masks. But both sides — California lawmakers and the Trump administration — are claiming victory. item.title: Reimagining Economic Opportunity as a Public Good
item.description: California researchers propose abundance-oriented policy solutions to make quality education, jobs, and internet access accessible for everyone.

item.title: Activista de salud mental para las tribus de California muere; posible víctima en asesinato-suicidio
item.description: Celinda Gonzales, de la tribu Yurok, trabajó para prevenir suicidios entre los nativos americanos tras sufrir pérdidas familiares. "Era amiga de muchos", afirmó la tribu.

item.title: Newsom arremete contra los «tiburones de reclamos» de los veteranos firmando ley que prohíbe cobrar comisión por ayudar con el VA
item.description: Muchos veteranos recurren a empresas privadas para obtener ayuda para presentar reclamos por discapacidad en el Departamento de Asuntos de Veteranos y luego enfrentan facturas que ascienden a miles de dólares.
